about: Known reasons a Zcash wallet shows zero or loses access after a restore or a network upgrade, with what to try; none of these steps ever needs your seed or keys on a website.

rows.symptom: I restored my Zodl (Zashi) seed in another wallet and my balance is zero or too small.
rows.when: restoring a Zodl or Zashi seed in another wallet
rows.advice: Wallets keep change at different addresses, so a restore can miss coins. In the Zkool app choose Restore account, open Advanced Options and make sure 'Use Internal Change' is on (it is by default). Set a birth height at or before your wallet's start: 2419000 covers any wallet created in Zashi, and a phrase that is older than that needs an earlier height. Let it sync fully. Zingo 3.0 or later also reads Zodl seeds. Type your seed only into the wallet app on your own device, never into a website or for someone who messages you.

rows.symptom: I opened my Zashi or Zodl seed in Cake Wallet and some of my ZEC is missing.
rows.when: restoring a Zashi or Zodl seed in Cake Wallet
rows.advice: Cake can't see the one-time addresses Zodl uses for sends to TEX addresses (such as Binance deposits) and for swap refunds, so ZEC sitting there doesn't show. Restore the seed in Zodl, Zingo or Zkool instead; Zodl itself finds those one-time addresses. If you want to use Cake, create a new Cake wallet and send your balance to it from the wallet that shows it.

rows.symptom: Zodl showed my balance, then after the Ironwood migration (or an app update) it shows zero and no history.
rows.when: after the in-app Orchard to Ironwood migration or an app update
rows.advice: First check your recovery phrase is written down and matches what Zodl shows. Then resync: on iOS delete and reinstall Zodl, on Android use Zodl's resync steps. If it is still zero, restore the same phrase in Zkool ('Use Internal Change' on, early birth height) or Zingo. If both still show zero, email support@zodl.com; forum cases like this were still open in October.

rows.symptom: YWallet no longer works or won't send my ZEC.
rows.advice: YWallet dropped Zcash support at Ironwood and its developer points users to Zkool, which comes from the same developer. Install Zkool, choose Restore account, enter your YWallet seed in the app, set an early birth height and let it sync. You don't need to change 'Use Internal Change': with it on, Zkool still finds YWallet's change. Type your seed only into the wallet app on your own device.

rows.symptom: The Zcash MetaMask Snap won't open or shield, and I can't reach my ZEC.
rows.when: since the Ironwood upgrade; the Snap's NU7 update was still unreleased on 9 Nov 2026
rows.advice: Your coins stay on the chain. MetaMask approved the Snap's Ironwood release on 4 Nov 2026, and its NU7 update is being audited. The maintainers say that update will show recovery words that open the funds in Zodl or Zkool. Update the Snap (now called 'Zcash WebZjs Wallet') from MetaMask's Snaps directory when it arrives. Never type your MetaMask secret recovery phrase into a website or 'recovery tool', and ignore anyone who messages you offering help.

rows.symptom: I have an old transparent private key (often starting with K or L) and no wallet will import it or show the balance.
rows.when: importing a paper or exported transparent key from an old wallet
rows.advice: Zkool can import an old transparent private key (starting with 5, K or L): turn 'Use Internal Change' off when you import it. An address with more than 100,000 tiny payouts may still fail to sync until the fix for Zkool issue #1619 ships in a release. Zallet can't import a bare key yet; it only helps if you still have a zcashd wallet.dat file. If the key is very old or was ever shared, treat it as public: move the coins to a new wallet and never send new funds to that address.

rows.symptom: I restored my old Trust Wallet seed and my ZEC isn't there.
rows.when: restoring an old (for example 2020) Trust Wallet seed
rows.advice: Trust Wallet shows only some coins after a restore, so first add ZEC to the coin list in Trust Wallet and wait for it to load. If it still shows nothing, the forum's advice is to restore the seed in Zkool, which reads only the Zcash part. That seed also controls your other coins, so move those with Trust Wallet first if you can, and type it only into the app on your own device. Trust Wallet only shows coins you add with 'Manage crypto', so add Zcash there first. To send ZEC from Trust Wallet after NU7 (6 Nov 2026), update the app: older versions build a transaction format the network now rejects. If you restore the seed in Zkool instead, install it only from its GitHub releases or the official app stores, and remember the seed also controls your other coins.

rows.symptom: My old zc... (Sprout) ZEC can't be moved any more.
rows.when: since NU7 (block 3,543,405, 6 Nov 2026), which froze about 12,224 ZEC still in Sprout
rows.advice: Sprout coins are not destroyed, but no software can spend them now and no recovery plan has been approved. Keep your old wallet.dat or keys backed up offline and follow the Zcash forum for any future recovery proposal. Transparent t1 coins from the same era are not frozen and can still be moved. Anyone offering to 'unfreeze' Sprout for you is a scam.

rows.symptom: My Zodl send to Binance failed and the money isn't back in my balance.
rows.when: sending from Zodl to a tex1 (Binance) address
rows.advice: Zodl first moves the coins to a one-time transparent address it owns, then on to Binance; if the second step fails, the coins wait there. In Zodl's Activity, open the transaction just before your send (0.00015 ZEC) and copy its t1 address (not Binance's tex1). Turn on Tor protection, then in Settings long-press the ZODL logo to open Discover Funds, paste the t1 address and tap Scan address.

rows.symptom: A swap or CrossPay payment from Zodl failed and I never got my ZEC back.
rows.when: swapping or paying through NEAR Intents inside Zodl
rows.advice: Refunds are usually automatic to the refund address set when the swap was made. If 24 hours have passed with nothing back, look up your swap's deposit address or transaction ID on explorer.near-intents.org and file a request with NEAR support through the link in Zodl's help article; manual refunds can take a couple of days. You never need to give anyone your seed for a refund.

rows.symptom: My Keystone won't sign and I can't migrate or move my shielded ZEC.
rows.when: after the Ironwood upgrade (NU6.3) on Keystone firmware older than 3.0.2
rows.advice: Update the Keystone to the Cypherpunk firmware 3.0.2 or later (by microSD or USB, following Zodl's guide), then sign the migration or send again from Zodl. Your seed stays on the Keystone the whole time.

rows.symptom: Shielded ZEC I sent to my Brave Wallet never showed up, though the explorer says it went through.
rows.when: receiving shielded ZEC after the Ironwood upgrade (NU6.3)
rows.advice: New shielded payments now land in the Ironwood pool, and Brave turned Ironwood support on by default in version 1.97.56 (7 Oct 2026). Update Brave on desktop and let the Zcash account sync fully. If the funds still don't show, use 'Reset ZCash sync state' at brave://settings/web3, then let it sync again. If that doesn't help, open a ticket with Brave support.

rows.symptom: My send fails with 'incorrect consensus branch id' and the coins never leave.
rows.when: after a network upgrade (NU6.3 in July, NU7 on 6 Nov 2026) in a wallet or signer that hasn't updated
rows.advice: Nothing is lost: the network refused a transaction built with old rules, so the coins never moved. Since NU7 the error usually says the transaction version is invalid, or names the consensus branch ID. Update the wallet app and any hardware firmware (Vultisig Android is fixed in 1.0.124; Trust Wallet needs its latest version). If your device gets no update (Ledger stopped updating apps for the original Nano S), restore its 24 words on a supported Ledger such as a Nano S Plus, Flex or Stax. Don't type a hardware wallet's words into a phone or desktop wallet unless you first move your other coins: those words protect everything on the device.

rows.symptom: Zkool's Ironwood migration is stuck at 'Waiting 0s' and makes no progress.
rows.when: running Zkool's Orchard to Ironwood migration
rows.advice: This was a known Zkool bug when a small leftover Orchard amount (about 0.005 to 0.0062 ZEC) fell in a 'dead zone'. It was fixed in Zkool 6.29.0; the current release is 6.36.0. Update Zkool and run the migration again. If it still stalls, lock that small leftover note in coin control and run it again.
